bibl.title: Social Contexts of the Biblical Quotations in the Letters of Frange.

Mattias Brand & Eline Scheerlinck (edd.), Religious Identifications in Late Antique Papyri: 3rd-12th Century Egypt (London - New York, 2023) pp. 248-277, figg.
